source.restated: T6 asks for a game like a private reference game by its name. Restated here as what that case's checklist holds the game to, without the name (it may not appear in public files) and without engine words. The case as written is evals/cases/T6.json, whose prompt is kept privately

prompt: A first-person co-op shooter for me and up to three friends on our phones, at night in moonlit ruins with fog, firelight and a grainy old look. It should feel heavy: guns that kick and flash, a dodge, a quick melee. Waves of creatures crawl out of the ground and grow every wave, between waves you pick one of three cards that changes how you fight, and it ends with one huge boss.

ledger.means: Seen through the player's eyes, a weapon in hand

ledger.words: It should feel heavy: guns that kick and flash, a dodge, a quick melee
ledger.means: Each gun kicks and flashes, there is a dodge and a quick melee, and moving and stopping have weight

ledger.words: Waves of creatures crawl out of the ground and grow every wave
ledger.means: Enemies rise from the ground in waves that grow, and show a tell before they hit

ledger.words: between waves you pick one of three cards that changes how you fight
ledger.means: Between waves each player picks one card of three, and it changes how they fight for the rest of the run

ledger.words: it ends with one huge boss
ledger.means: The run ends with one huge enemy with its own health bar: won when it falls, lost when everyone has

ledger.words: at night in moonlit ruins with fog, firelight and a grainy old look
ledger.means: Dark moonlit ruins, fog and firelight, a retro grain
It plays on phones with touch controls

ledger.words: for me and up to three friends
ledger.means: Two to four friends play the same run together

multiplayer.bar: Two players in one game, in sync: each screen shows the other player as a character where they really are, in the same round or run, and each sees their own score as their own.

policy: The private reference game's name and names never reach the game

control.text: The game includes a working chess board
